name: walkietalkie
description: Browser walkie-talkie: half-duplex group voice over a WebRTC P2P mesh with server-enforced floor control

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace client & wait
scripts.build: tsc --build shared server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build shared server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
